name: Mesa
description:
Mesa is the open-source 3D graphics library providing OpenGL, Vulkan, and OpenCL implementations for Linux GPUs. This portable package bundles cutting-edge Mesa drivers to test the latest graphics driver features on any distribution.

Features:
- Up-to-date Vulkan drivers including RADV (AMD), ANV (Intel), and NVK (NVIDIA)
- Full OpenGL 4.6 and OpenGL ES 3.2 support for hardware-accelerated rendering
- Cutting-edge shader compiler improvements (ACO) delivering faster game loading
- Diagnostic tools and environment configuration for testing graphics hardware
- Can be used seamlessly to run games and binaries with the latest graphics stack
